_comment: Human-approval ledger for the two mandatory pipeline gates (see ADR 0008). Gate 1 = dramaturgy approved before visual prompts begin. Gate 2 = motion script approved before video generation begins. This is an HONEST record: it certifies that a human approved a specific artifact on a date. The sha256 pins WHICH bytes were approved so post-approval drift is visible; it CANNOT verify that the taste behind the approval was sound. pipeline_integrity.py consumes this file: artifacts beyond a gate with no record here = FAIL; a sha256 that no longer matches disk = WARN (post-approval em-dash cleanups are legitimate, the WARN just makes them visible).

gates.1: Dramaturgy approval - human sign-off before visual prompts begin
gates.2: Motion script approval - human sign-off before video generation begins
